headsticker.title: Head swap
headsticker.subtitle: Replace faces in a photo with your fursona head sticker, then post it
headsticker.disabled: The head sticker tool is not available yet
headsticker.privacy: Your photo never leaves your device: face detection runs in the browser, only finds where faces are, never identifies anyone, and stores no facial data. Only the composed image you choose to save is uploaded.
headsticker.noFaces: No faces detected. Use "Add box manually" to place one yourself.
headsticker.detectFailed: The detection model failed to load (the first run downloads about 10 MB). You can still add boxes manually.
headsticker.empty: Pick a photo to start. Group photos work too; each face can get a different head.
headsticker.canvasHint: Click a face box to select it and drag to move; adjust size, angle and flip on the right.

stickers.title: Head stickers
stickers.empty: No stickers yet. In your gallery, mark a transparent PNG of your head as a "head sticker". Stickers marked by friends appear here too.
stickers.selectFace: Select a face in the photo first

export.title: Save image
export.note: The composed image is saved to the gallery as a "physical photo" marked as head-swap output, then taken to the new post page. You are responsible for the likeness of other people in the photo.

notify.stickerLoadFailed: Sticker failed to load; the image storage may not allow cross-origin reads
notify.pickFursona: Choose a fursona to save into first
